brief:
Israel's election commission rejected allegations of electoral fraud promoted by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu against Arab political parties on Wednesday, according to Al-Monitor. The Arab parties could prove decisive in removing Netanyahu from power following a contentious vote. Netanyahu's accusations targeted the parties that may hold crucial leverage in coalition negotiations.

The dismissal by electoral authorities undercuts Netanyahu's public narrative about the election's integrity, even as Arab parties position themselves as potential kingmakers in post-election political negotiations.
dek: Israeli electoral authorities on Wednesday rejected allegations promoted by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of fraud by Arab parties, who could hold the key to removing him from power after a divisive vote.
title: Israeli election commission dismisses Netanyahu fraud claims against Arab parties
